manual.assortedworld.chapter.end_portals: You can place them in an opening of 3x3 to 9x9 on a floor, wall or ceiling. If they are all facing the same way you can construct a End Portal of your own using a Void Striker.

Strike any frame of a finished ring with a void striker and the end portal will open. Ender flames set inside a closed Void Portal Frame ring will also open the portal.

On end stone the flames will burn forever.
A void portal frame is an end portal frame you can make yourself. They are very slow to break as you would expect.
Void crystal is found on the End islands. It is quite rare and needs an iron pickaxe level or higher to break.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.plants.glow: A glowstone seed takes on the underside of a netherrack ceiling and ripens before bursting into a blob of glowstone.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.plants.gunp: A reed breaks back down into gunpowder one for one.
Gunpowder reed grows like sugar cane and glows faintly. Plant it once and it keeps growing, which turns a one off pile of gunpowder into a supply.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.randomite.f: It generates all over and looks enough like the other ores you could mistake it for another.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.randomite.o: Randomite looks like one more ore in the wall and drops as any of them. What it gives is decided when it breaks, not when it generates, so two blocks side by side rarely drop the same.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.runes.runes: Runes are carved blocks that hold an effect and hand it to whoever stands or uses them. There are sixteen, and they are not crafted: every one in the world was placed by a Ancient Structure.
Fountains are large stone structures surrounded by flowing water. Watch out for what is inside.
Pyramids are big decaying structures lost to time in the desert.
Ruins are what is left of a civilisation that was here first. Most have decayed down to a footprint and a few standing walls, but they still hold treasures worth exploring.
Snowballs are enormous stacked drifts of snow and ice that look a great deal like a snowman left to grow.
Spires are towers of stone reaching for the sky.
Water domes sit on the sea floor, ribbed with a material that varies from dome to dome.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.world_gen.d: Desert wells are not just a well. The shaft under them runs ten to thirty blocks down through the sandstone to a chest, and the deeper the swim the better what is waiting at the bottom.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.world_gen.f:
Islands hang high over the ground and take after the land below them.

Getting up to one is the whole problem. Nothing grows a bridge for you.
manual.assortedworld.chapter.world_gen.w:
Wild fields of wheat, carrots, potatoes or beetroot grow on the plains, watered by holes dug in among the rows. Melons come up in loose patches around as well. Stray saplings and the stumps of felled trees are scattered through the woods.

The desert has more variety with fields of cactus, sandstone pillars standing out of the dunes, and pits sunk into the sand in terraces.
manual.assortedworld.description: What this mod buries, builds and grows out in the world, and what is worth going to look for.
